p: Who was either the author, or a chief singer, to whom it was committed.
earth from the rising of the: To plead against his deceitful people before heaven and earth.
perfection of beauty: Because God had chosen it to have his Name there called on and also his image shines there in the doctrine of the law.
fire shall devour before him: As when God gave his law in mount Sinai he appeared terrible with thunder and tempest, so will he appear terrible to take account for the keeping of it.
the earth: As witnessing against the hypocrites.
saints together unto me: God in respect to his elect calls the whole body holy, saints and his people.
sacrifice: Who should know that sacrifices are sealed by the covenant between God and his people, and not set religion in it.
reprove thee for thy sacrifices or: For I pass not for sacrifices unless the true use is there, which is to confirm your faith.
For every beast of the forest: Though he delighted in sacrifice, yet he had no need for man's help in it.
Will I eat the flesh of: Though man's life for the infirmity of it has need of food, yet God whose life quickens all the world, has no need of such means.
pay thy vows unto the most: Show yourself mindful of God's benefits by thanksgiving.
What hast thou to do to: Why do you pretend to be of my people and talk of my covenant, seeing that you are a hypocrite?
instruction: To live according to my word.
thou consentedst with him: He shows what the fruits of them who contemn God's word are.
sittest and speakest against thy brother: He notes the cruelty of hypocrites who in their talk or judgment do not spare their own mother's sons.
set them in order before thine: I will write all your wicked deeds in a roll, and make you read and acknowledge them, whether you will or not.
praise glorifieth me: Under which is contained faith and invocation.
ordereth his conversation aright will I: As God has appointed.
shew the salvation of God: That is, declare myself to be his Saviour.
